title: Merchandise Purchases — Note Service Day Count for Debit, Cash and Bank Card Units
content:
On a refund of a Finch Note left undeducted on a Merchandise Purchases unit, the note service days run from the purchase date to the request date and are counted by the tender on the purchase record:

| Tender on the purchase record | Note service days |
|---|---|
| debit card or cash — the money left the customer on the purchase date | calendar days from the purchase date to the request date, counting both dates |
| bank credit card | those calendar days, not counting the purchase date |

A unit paid by any other tender is outside this rule.

*Hypothetical:* purchase on 2 February, request on 1 March — 28 days for a debit or cash unit, 27 days for a bank card unit.
